description: P2: YouTube parser, IFrame player, host-controlled sync with drift correction, server media/playback/queue handlers, QueuePanel. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Do plan.md tasks P2-1 through P2-4 in order (design.md section 8 and section 6 media/queue bullets).
Verify the motion/react import path and IFrame API CSP needs.
acceptance_criteria: parseYouTubeUrl tests cover every row of design section 16
Non-host playback:command returns not_host and leaves state unchanged (server test and smoke)
Late joiner snapshot has media, position, queue
verification: npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm test; npm run build
npm --prefix signaling-server test; npm --prefix signaling-server run build
background server + npm --prefix signaling-server run smoke
findings: Done. Server: Room.setMedia/playbackCommand/mediaFinished/queue* with ref-copy replies, handlers in signaling-server/src/handlers/{media,playback,queue}.ts; shared applyCommand (host time clamped to [now-2s, now]). Client: parse, loadApi, useYouTubePlayer, syncController (decideSync/detectSeek pure + FollowerSync), YouTubePlayer, QueuePanel, SourceSelector, YouTubeUrlForm; Queue tab in Sidebar and MobileTabBar. Verified: motion/react import path works (motion 14.14.0, build passes). lucide-react 1.77 has no Youtube brand icon (MonitorPlay used). Not browser-verified: YT player host option youtube-nocookie.com, autoplay overlay, seek detection, oEmbed CORS. Gate: root typecheck/lint/test(159)/build OK; server typecheck/test(73)/build OK; smoke 40/40 against a background server (stopped).
